mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment exceeding 8.0% (UNRATE > 8.0) signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 8.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 228.0) combined with stagnant policy rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) signals unresponsive monetary policy to inflation, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS declining for 3+ months), a further rate decline compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during monetary easing cycles (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 700 thousand units (HOUST < 700) signals weakening housing market demand, reducing construction activity and consumer confidence, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 700 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production level (INDPRO) indicates strengthening supply chain activity, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO is above 97.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 400000) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 7.5) signals robust consumer demand and labor market health, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing recovery phase (HOUST > 700), sustained housing starts above 700 thousand units signal strengthening housing demand, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during housing recovery phases (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
